en: A black and white postcard showing a large, stately institutional building with a central dome and symmetrical wings. The architecture is early 20th century European. In front of the building, a group of boys or young men, some in uniform, are standing and posing. The building has large windows and a notable entrance with steps. The text on the postcard includes 'Zagreb', 'Konvikt, na šalati', and a handwritten date '29/IX 1915.'
